answer_2.quote: We use Passage Recall@k as our evaluation metric... The exact match (EM) score computes the percentage of questions for which the predicted answer exactly matches the ground truth.

answer_4.quote: The propositions and passages were provided to an expert without knowing which model generated each proposition. The expert annotated three scores from different perspectives for each proposition: (1) whether the proposition is fully supported by the passage, (2) whether the proposition is minimal and cannot be further split into separate propositions, (3) whether the proposition is self-contained.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assessed each generated proposition on three criteria: faithfulness to the source passage, minimality, and stand‑alone clarity.
